tests.name: Connected through another city
tests.hint: 0 and 1 aren't directly connected, but both connect to 2.

tests.name: Random small
tests.data:
import random
random.seed(547)
mats = []
for _ in range(30):
    n = random.randint(1, 8)
    m = [[1 if i == j else 0 for j in range(n)] for i in range(n)]
    for _ in range(random.randint(0, n)):
        a, b = random.randrange(n), random.randrange(n)
        m[a][b] = m[b][a] = 1
    mats.append(m)
